scope: Read-only audit of the pinned chest-CT classification task. No clinical data download, runtime launch, model trial, evaluator execution or visual acceptance.

contract.specialist_tools: Agent may install tools; source reports and labels may not be looked up. No particular image viewer prescribed.

staging.isolation: Compose mounts cache, bootstrap code, gold derivation and credentials only in bootstrap, with scan/label names in shared solver data. Declaration inspected; no runtime isolation verification.
staging.label_derivation: 17 ordered categories; positive-only phrase match retains 1; negative-only retains 0; both or neither drops the category. Positive matches have same-clause negation guards; several categories have no negative phrase rule.
staging.clinical_review_limit: README asserts hand verification, but no patient-specific review record was available. Phrase rules do not establish complete clinical truth.
missing_cited_files: assets/ct_abnormality/assets/manifest.yaml returned GitHub 404 at the pinned revision; evaluator docstring references it.

scoring.reward: 1 iff all retained gold labels have matching parsed predictions; otherwise 0
scoring.extra_predictions: Unrequested label names are not scored
scoring.missing_prediction: Wrong even for a gold-negative label
scoring.format: Case-insensitive names, first-colon split, blank/comment lines ignored, published true/false synonym sets accepted; duplicate parsed names overwrite earlier values.
scoring.diagnostics: metrics.json retains per-label evidence, predictions, accuracy and confusion counts; only binary reward is serialized in reward.txt.
scoring.limits: No localization score, full-report score, image-search completeness score or independent diagnostic adjudication. No local score was generated.
